title: [BUG] Unable to gain context from video files
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [X] probably Anthropic API. But its claude launched inside vscode

- Claude CLI version: 1.0.35 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: macOS 15.5
- Terminal: native zsh terminal

## Bug Description
when asking it to read a video file to gain context it seems to error out. 
I was expecting these to work since these are multimodal models

## Steps to Reproduce
1. ask it to gain context via some video file and give it the file path

## Output
```
⏺ Read(bug.mov)
  ⎿  Error: This tool cannot read binary files. The file 
     appears to be a binary .mov file. Please use appropriate 
     tools for binary file analysis.
```
author: nsrCodes
